name: Ideas of Development
overview: However, for comparison between countries, total income is not such a useful measure. Countries with higher income are more developed than countries with lower income. Income and per capita income, though very often used, is only one aspect of development.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: However, for comparison between countries, total _____ is not such a useful measure.
vsaq.answer: However, for comparison between countries, total income is not such a useful measure.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Health and education indicators, such as the ones we used in comparison of _____ Pradesh and Haryana, are among them.
vsaq.answer: Health and education indicators, such as the ones we used in comparison of Himachal Pradesh and Haryana, are among them.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: They have greater say in household decisions, including children’s _____, health, birth, upkeep etc.
vsaq.answer: They have greater say in household decisions, including children’s education, health, birth, upkeep etc.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: _____ as progress over time Some countries are ahead of others in terms of human development indicators.
vsaq.answer: Development as progress over time Some countries are ahead of others in terms of human development indicators.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Even now, in many areas, _____, particularly girls, are not able to achieve secondary level schooling because government/ society has not provided the required facilities.
vsaq.answer: Even now, in many areas, children, particularly girls, are not able to achieve secondary level schooling because government/ society has not provided the required facilities.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The criterion we may use depends on the purpose of _____.
vsaq.answer: The criterion we may use depends on the purpose of comparison.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Some states have lower Infant Mortality Rate because they have adequate provision of basic _____ care and educational facilities.
vsaq.answer: Some states have lower Infant Mortality Rate because they have adequate provision of basic health care and educational facilities.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Different _____ can have different developmental goals and 2.
vsaq.answer: Different persons can have different developmental goals and 2.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Himachali parents have ambitious educational goals for their _____, just as for their boys.
vsaq.answer: Himachali parents have ambitious educational goals for their girls, just as for their boys.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: As the years went by, these _____ were improved and expanded.
vsaq.answer: As the years went by, these facilities were improved and expanded.

mcqs.explanation: In this country, people are neither very rich nor extremely poor, while most citizens in country B are poor and one person is extremely rich.

mcqs.explanation: So, greater income itself is considered to be one important goal.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.explanation: Though both the countries have identical average income, country A is preferred because it has more equitable distribution.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.question: In Ideas of Development, which option best completes this statement? Health and _____ indicators, such as the ones we used in comparison of Himachal Pradesh and Haryana, are among them.
mcqs.explanation: Health and education indicators, such as the ones we used in comparison of Himachal Pradesh and Haryana, are among them.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.question: Which term correctly completes this textbook-based statement? For comparing _____, their income is considered to be one of the most important attributes.
mcqs.explanation: For comparing countries, their income is considered to be one of the most important attributes.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.explanation: Hence, we compare the average income which is total income of the country divided by total population.

mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.explanation: Since countries have different populations, comparing total income will not tell us what an average person is likely to earn.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.question: Select the word that correctly completes the idea. Those with per capita income of US $995 or less per annum in 2017 are called low-income _____.

mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.explanation: They have greater say in household decisions, including children’s education, health, birth, upkeep etc.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.explanation: Suppose the records show that the average income in a country has been increasing over a period.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.question: Select the word that correctly completes the idea. A welcome trend in Himachal _____ is the lower gender bias.
mcqs.explanation: A welcome trend in Himachal Pradesh is the lower gender bias.

mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.question: Which term correctly completes this textbook-based statement? So, if the per capita income were to be used as the measure of _____, Haryana would be considered the most developed and Bihar the least developed state of the three.

mcqs.explanation: Whatever people like and should have, they will be able to get with greater income.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.question: Select the word that correctly completes the idea. Child mortality (children dying within a few years of birth) in Himachal _____ is lower for girls than for boys, in contrast to most other states.
mcqs.explanation: Child mortality (children dying within a few years of birth) in Himachal Pradesh is lower for girls than for boys, in contrast to most other states.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.question: In Ideas of Development, which option best completes this statement? _____ with per capita income of US $12,055 and above per annum in 2017 are called high income countries or rich countries.
mcqs.explanation: Countries with per capita income of US $12,055 and above per annum in 2017 are called high income countries or rich countries.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.question: Which term correctly completes this textbook-based statement? Similarly, some states have better indicators of _____ development, though within a state, there may be variations.
mcqs.explanation: Similarly, some states have better indicators of human development, though within a state, there may be variations.
mcqs.subject: Social Science

mcqs.question: Identify the missing concept in this chapter statement. So, income by itself is not a completely adequate indicator of material goods and services that _____ are able to use.
